Lemma
[Nonround solutions cannot have plane limits] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0121 ↗ prop:chow-iv-plane-not-backward-pointwise-limit 1. ch29:29.31\group Backward Geometry

If $g(t)$ is nonround and $q_i\in S^2$, then no unrescaled pointed smooth limit of $(S^2,g(t_i+t),q_i)$, $t_i\to -\infty $, is the flat plane.
